block-handbooktext-ecentrifuge:
Allows grinding and processing all perishable items/foods directly into compost. The amount of compost obtained is half that of the vanilla method. Also supports custom processing recipes, which will be displayed in the description of the processor and the item itself.
Supports automatic loading and unloading via hoppers.
block-handbooktext-erecycler: Multiblock recycler (2×2×2), 32 V. Processes perishables into compost and custom recipes; hoppers supported.
erecycler-structure-hint: RMB: 8 iron + 2 copper plates → switch + 4 coils → 2 rotors + 16 copper 128 V wires.
construction-handbook-assembly-hint: Right-click the placed controller while holding materials (like the water wheel):
block-handbooktext-ehammer: Simplifies and automates work on the anvil. Multiblock 3×4×2, 128 V. Assemble with steel plates, copper coils, iron and copper plates (RMB on controller). Chance of bonus materials. Supports hoppers.
ehammer-structure-hint: Right-click the controller with materials: 8 steel plates → 4 copper coils → 4 iron plates → 4 copper plates.
ehammer-structure-hint-short: RMB with materials — assemble (see block hints)
block-handbooktext-esieve: Electric sieve for sorting crushed materials. Multiblock 5×3×3, 128 V. Assemble with steel plates, copper coils, iron and copper plates (RMB on controller). Supports hoppers.
esieve-structure-hint: Right-click the controller with materials: 8 steel plates → 4 copper coils → 4 iron plates → 4 copper plates.
esieve-structure-hint-short: RMB with materials — assemble (see block hints)
block-handbooktext-epress: Allows creating certain items by pressing with a mold. Multiblock 2×2×2, 128 V. Assemble with steel plates, copper coils, iron and copper plates (RMB on controller). Supports hoppers.
epress-structure-hint: Right-click the controller with materials: 6 steel plates → 4 copper coils → 4 iron plates → 4 copper plates.
epress-structure-hint-short: RMB with materials — assemble (see block hints)
block-handbooktext-edrawing: Allows creating elongated items by extruding metal. Multiblock 3×4×3, 128 V. Assemble with steel plates, copper coils, iron and copper plates (RMB on controller). Supports hoppers.
eextruder-structure-hint: Right-click the controller with materials: 8 steel plates → 4 copper coils → 4 iron plates → 4 copper plates.
eextruder-structure-hint-short: RMB with materials — assemble (see block hints)
block-handbooktext-ecrusher: Multiblock crusher (2×2×2), 128 V. Crushes ore with bonus outputs; hoppers supported.
block-handbooktext-eaquaaccum: Electric aqua accumulator that condenses water from air moisture. Multiblock 2×2×2, 32 V. Assemble with iron plates, copper coils and copper plates (RMB on controller). Capacity: 100 L.
eaquaaccum-structure-hint: Right-click the controller with materials: 6 iron plates → 2 copper coils → 2+2 copper plates.
eaquaaccum-structure-hint-short: RMB with materials — assemble (see block hints)
block-handbooktext-eblastfurnace: Electric blast furnace for smelting ore with flux. Multiblock 3×2×2, 128 V. Assemble with steel plates, copper coils and tier 3 refractory bricks (RMB on controller). Supports hoppers.
eblastfurnace-structure-hint: Right-click the controller with materials: 8 steel plates → 4 copper coils → 4+4 tier 3 refractory bricks.
eblastfurnace-structure-hint-short: RMB with materials — assemble (see block hints)
ecrusher-structure-hint: Right-click the controller with materials: 5 iron + 2 copper plates.
ecrusher-structure-hint-short: RMB with materials — assemble (see block hints)
